name: CardiacLens v9.10.347.172
notes: v172 repairs event-title consistency across the Events tile, Events queue, action card, and reminder text. A single due or missed event now carries its name through every level of the interface; multiple due or missed events show the count on the tile and the names in the queue. Version/help/service worker updated for deploy.
label: EventsTitleConsistencyRepair
summary: Repairs Events tile and queue title consistency so the active event name is visible everywhere it appears.
whatsNew: Events tile now shows the event name clearly for a single due or missed item.
Events queue rows now use the same event title source and keep the name readable on mobile.
Event action cards and reminder notices now show the same event name consistently.
Multiple due or missed items still show a count on the tile and list names inside the queue.
fixes: Fixed Log button from Events queue being blocked by the already-open queue modal.
Fixed stale queue/tile state after Dismiss or Snooze.
Fixed cramped mobile layout in missed/due queue rows.
Preserved deploy cache advancement for clean GitHub Pages/iPhone refresh.
testing: Verified JavaScript syntax with node --check all.js.
Verified inline script syntax extracted from index.html.
